title: ChatStore get() and find_direct_by_contact_id(): identical row mapping code duplicated
description: chat.rs: get(), find_direct_by_contact_id(), and list() each contain the same row-to-Chat mapping code (6-field tuple unpack, debug_assert on timestamps, crate::util::unix_secs_to_rfc3339 calls, Chat struct construction). The code is 15-20 lines per call site. Extract to a fn row_to_chat(row: &rusqlite::Row) -> rusqlite::Result<Chat> analogous to how message.rs has row_to_message. The debug_assert duplication is especially concerning — an assert variant (release vs debug) change would need to be applied in 3 places.
